method.rule: Adapt the upstream text; do not paraphrase it. Each local skill keeps the upstream structure, section names, leading words, and behavioural instructions, and edits only what the workflow changes: the tracker becomes the central bundle, the tracker operations become wfctl commands, and the review gates are named where upstream names a tracker label.

remapNote: The 0.9.0 rewrite replaced twelve local skills with one installed skill (templates/skill/wfctl/) plus guidance the CLI prints at its own call sites (templates/guidance/). Every local path in this record pointed at the old skills/ tree and none of them existed any more, so an attribution record for MIT-licensed text named sixteen files that were not there. The text itself moved rather than went: the four verbatim files are intact under templates/guidance/references/. Paths below are the current ones, and where a derivation no longer ships, it says so.

withdrawn.note: Dropped in the 0.9.0 rewrite and not replaced. It was a user-invoked re-pitch in Simplified Technical English; nothing in the current tree carries it, and this record listed it as though it still shipped.
